body_text: `DenoisingAutoEncoderLoss` raised a `RuntimeError` on transformers >= 5.0.0 whenever `tie_encoder_decoder=True` (the default). Since tying is the recommended TSDAE setting, this effectively broke TSDAE on v5 unless you pinned an older transformers.  | loss code | transformers 4.57.6 (<5) | transformers 5.9.0 (>=5) ||---|---|---|| before this PR | ✅ works | ❌ `RuntimeError` || with this PR | ✅ works | ✅ works |  The loss tied the encoder and decoder through the private `PreTrainedModel._tie_encoder_decoder_weights`. transformers v5 removed that helper and moved tying to a per model `_tied_weights_keys` mapping that only applies within a single `PreTrainedModel`. TSDAE keeps the encoder and decoder as two separate models, so the native v5 machinery cannot bridge them, and #3619 added the `RuntimeError` as a stopgap.Fixes #3737

body_text: Medications are recorded as being chronic or not in the models (defaultis false). Once recorded as chronic, each time a patient is prescribedthe medication an initial time, it will be kept track of in the Personclass. Then at each wellness encounter, the medication will be reneweduntil it is discontinued or the patient dies.Detailed Implementation Notes:- Person.chronicMedications is a new hash map that keeps track of  medications.- HealthRecord.Medication, State.MedicationOrder both now have a chronic  flag.- HealthRecord.Encounter has a flag for tracking weather meds were  renewed at this encounter. This is a dirty hack, but was necessary as  the code for Wellness encounter in State.Encounter.process was being  run multiple times, once for each module that waited for the Wellness  encounter. I want a better idea for doing this. The other ways to do  this take too much processing time (going through each medication like  we do for diagnoses; or checking each medication for the time it was  last renewed).- HealthRecord.medicationStart now take a boolean parameter to  indication whether a medication is chronic. If it is, it is added to  Person.chronicMedications. HealthRecord.medicationEnd checks for the  chronic flag on each medication being ended and removes it if so from  Person.chronicMedications.- In State.MedicationOrder.process, recognize chronic meds from models.  Chronic flag passed to HealthRecord.medicationStart.- In State.Encounter.process, code to renew chronic medications at each  wellness encounter. Uses Person.chronicMedications & HealthRecord.  medicationStart/.medicationEnd.- Modify Hypertension (hypertension.json) model to add chronic flag to  each medication. Also, while I was at it, I created full prescriptions  for each medication.- Update Java code Cardiovascular model to do chronic meds.- Update Unit Tests for HealthRecord.medicationStart.Before and After Visualizations:Before:![Screen Shot 2019-09-10 at 4 23 09 PM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1125826/64647989-0cac4280-d3e8-11e9-94f1-b31d80232648.png)After:![Screen Shot 2019-09-10 at 4 26 14 PM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1125826/64648016-1766d780-d3e8-11e9-9259-98656548764e.png)
